newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soy weaken, wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soy weaken, wheat steady.

text.p: CHICAGO, Sept 11 - FOB Gulf basis values for corn and soybeans slumped on Wednesday while wheat values were mostly steady.
"Everybody would like to see some bids but there is no demand," a dealer said.
Taiwan's FGEP corn-buying group bought a shipment of 54,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn from Mitsui at a tender on Wednesday for November delivery, traders said.
Three Philippine firms bought 35,000 tonnes of U.S. soft winter wheat rejected by China at $192 per tonne, including cost and freight, traders said on Wednesday.

But U.S. wheat exporters will have to be more aggressive to entice world grain buyers now that good harvests seem assured in Canada, the European Union, Australia and Argentina, wheat industry sources said.
Dealers quoted the following afternoon FOB U.S. Gulf values, basis Chicago futures, except hard red winter wheat basis Kansas City. (In cents per bushel).
